reason: I already have a smart display and speaker that do alarm, weather and calendar, and I've never actually moved my phone out of the bedroom. Another box on the nightstand for EUR 120 doesn't fix the habit, it just duplicates what I own.
objection: How accurate can a sleep and snoring estimate from a microphone and room sensing really be? If that's the one thing it does that my current setup doesn't, I'd want proof, and from a first small-batch product on a waitlist I can't get any.
would_change_my_mind: Independent reviews or a trial period showing the estimates are consistent, plus it working with my existing smart-home setup, at around EUR 90 or less.
